archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified for Industrial HMI
design_philosophy: This is a serious, production-grade engineering tool. The interface mimics physical calibration equipment (MoTeC i2, oscilloscopes). Minimalist, data-dense, highly restrained color palette. No neon, no generic SaaS rounded corners. Every pixel serves a functional purpose.

background.description: Deep graphite, prevents OLED smear and reduces eye strain.

surface.description: Gunmetal/steel panels for separating data zones.

text.description: High contrast for readability, never pure white.

accent.description: Steel-blue. Used strictly for active states, selected tabs, and focus indicators. Muted to maintain the industrial feel.

status.description: CRITICAL: Amber and Red are reserved EXCLUSIVELY for warnings, risk envelopes, and dangerous map zones. Do not use for generic active states.

primary_sans.usage: Headers, labels, button text, structural navigation.

monospace.usage: Numeric readouts, heatmap cell values, sensor IDs, technical data.

layout_spacing.grid_system: Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid. High density, 12-column foundation. Components snap tightly to grid lines.
layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense. Use gap-2 (8px), gap-4 (16px) for internal panel spacing. Use gap-6 (24px) between major panels.
layout_spacing.border_radius: Sharp. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm (2px max). No pill shapes.
layout_spacing.alignment: Strictly left-aligned or tabularly aligned for numbers. Asymmetric, multi-column dashboard layouts.

panels.behavior: Flat, no drop shadows. Use 1px inner border highlight if elevation is needed.

heatmap_table.cell: h-8 w-12 font-mono text-[11px] flex items-center justify-center border-r border-b border-black/20 select-none cursor-crosshair transition-colors

badges.classes: px-2 py-0.5 border text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider

sliders.thumb: w-3 h-5 bg-[#38BDF8] rounded-none border border-[#141416] cursor-ew-resize hover:bg-[#7DD3FC]

warning_banner.classes: border-l-4 border-l-[#EF4444] bg-[#7F1D1D]/20 border-y border-r border-[#EF4444]/20 p-3 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-none

wizard_stepper.container: flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs uppercase

fuel_map.text_contrast: Ensure cell text is white on dark stops, and black on light stops (or strictly use white text with heavy text-shadow for readability).

page_blueprints.wizard_intake: 2-column layout. Left: sequential data entry forms (engine displacement, cylinders, turbo, etc.) using dense inputs. Right: Real-time 'Safety Envelope' readout updating as parameters change.
page_blueprints.map_generation: Full-width dashboard. Top: Macro parameter sliders (AFR bias, timing aggressiveness). Middle: 2D Heatmap grids side-by-side (Fuel & Ignition). Bottom: Confidence score badges and warnings.
page_blueprints.review_compare: Overlay mode. Heatmap shows delta values (+2.5, -1.0) with Diverging scale. Right panel holds the 'Undo Stack' of regeneration history (git-commit style list).
page_blueprints.export_panel: Modal or slide-over panel. Grid of target systems (DIAG-SIM, Tune Inspector Pro) with monospaced export logs and JSON preview snippet.
page_blueprints.dashboard_home: Grid of saved profiles. Each card looks like a hardware memory slot, showing Engine ID, Date, and a mini-sparkline/confidence metric.

motion.philosophy: Industrial and instant. No long eases.
motion.hover_states: Instant color snap (0ms transition) for standard buttons, fast 100ms fade for map cells.
motion.data_updates: When data changes, flash the cell background momentarily in white or accent color to draw the engineer's eye, then settle.
motion.loading: Use monospace ASCII spinners or progress bars ( [||||||....] ) instead of circular SVG loaders.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG adherence. Text on heatmaps must be legible.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: ALL interactive elements must use data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='slider-afr-bias', data-testid='cell-fuel-1000-50').

background_textures.description: Gray engine bay - use as a highly darkened, low-opacity background for empty states or auth.
Stainless steel engine bay - use sparingly at 5% opacity for panel textures if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the primary grid layouts to maintain the tight 'Control Room' density. Do not rely heavily on pre-styled SaaS components like Shadcn Cards if they enforce too much padding or rounding.
Implement the 2D heatmaps using raw grid/flex or HTML tables with inline styles for dynamic background colors based on the value.
Force all numerical inputs and data readouts to use the monospace font.
Ensure 'Safety Envelope' warnings conditionally render with stark red/amber styling to break the monochrome UI intentionally.
